Ocho Rios Jamaica by rental car: how to get there, what to do nearby and how to book.

Getting there: Pick up at OCJ (Ian Fleming). Ocho Rios is a short drive away.

Blue Mountain coffee Jamaica by rental car: how to get there, what to do nearby and how to book.

Blue Mountain coffee. From the source. ✨

Drive up into the hills for the world-famous cup.

Rent a car and go see it for yourself.

Taste the world-famous coffee where it grows, high in the hills above Kingston.

Getting there: Pick up at Norman Manley or our Kingston offices. Allow an hour or more, and take it easy on the bends.

Make it a Blue Mountains morning, then come down for lunch in Kingston.
